headline: Plenković presents measures: Instead of 58 euros for electricity, you will pay 43 euros
summary: Croatia's government presented its 11th package of measures to protect households and businesses from rising prices. Under the plan, households would pay 43 euros instead of 58 euros for electricity.
why: Government price caps and subsidies on energy affect inflation, consumer spending and the fiscal balance, which matter for Croatian government bonds and the wider economy.
